plan.failureSummary: The chatbot backend endpoint (/api/chat) is returning HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors, causing empty assistant response bubbles and failing chatbot compliance evaluation.
observedIndicators: Browser network logs show multiple HTTP 500 errors on requests to https://briefcase.chat/api/chat (x3).
Live screenshot and page analysis confirm empty assistant response bubbles (placeholder 'A' avatar with no message text) after submitting queries.
The page.ai evaluation correctly identified empty responses and returned status: 'FAIL' with descriptive issues.
The test explicitly runs with cache: false, confirming the failure is not due to stale cached instructions.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix the /api/chat backend endpoint on briefcase.chat.
remediationSteps.details: Investigate server-side error logs and AI service integration for https://briefcase.chat/api/chat to resolve the 500 Internal Server Error causing failed text generation.

plan.notes: The test executed as intended with cache: false, and accurately detected that the web application's chat backend is failing with 500 errors when answering prompts.
